\section*{Question 5}

Let \(f\) be the function satisfying \(f^{\prime}(x)=-3 x f(x)\), for all real numbers \(x\), with \(f(1)=4\) and \(\lim _{x \rightarrow \infty} f(x)=0\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Evaluate \(\int_{1}^{\infty}-3 x f(x) d x\). Show the work that leads to your answer.
\item[(b)] Use Euler's method, starting at \(x=1\) with a step size of 0.5 , to approximate \(f(2)\).
\item[(c)] Write an expression for \(y=f(x)\) by solving the differential equation \(\frac{d y}{d x}=-3 x y\) with the initial condition \(f(1)=4\).
\item[(a)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \int_{1}^{\infty}-3 x f(x) d x \\
& =\int_{1}^{\infty} f^{\prime}(x) d x=\lim _{b \rightarrow \infty} \int_{1}^{b} f^{\prime}(x) d x=\left.\lim _{b \rightarrow \infty} f(x)\right|_{1} ^{b} \\
& =\lim _{b \rightarrow \infty} f(b)-f(1)=0-4=-4
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
f(1.5) & \approx f(1)+f^{\prime}(1)(0.5) \\
& =4-3(1)(4)(0.5)=-2 \\
f(2) & \approx-2+f^{\prime}(1.5)(0.5) \\
& \approx-2-3(1.5)(-2)(0.5)=2.5
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(c)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \frac{1}{y} d y=-3 x d x \\

& y=C e^{-3 / 2 x^{2}} \\

& y=4 e^{3 / 2} e^{-3 / 2 x^{2}}
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
